name: Tears
summary: Pair of big blue tear drops falling in turn: use for crying, sadness or heartache.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 390 px wide at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: drop colour; a darker edge is added

params.name: anim
params.note: fall = drops fall in turn and fade, bob = gentle float

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames
